answer: The defence is the price itself, and the price does not negotiate. Before the stamp comes an examination charge of $7, charged again each time a name fails, and a name that cannot pay it never gets stamped. Every entry must show Hoodbound journeyman falconer perch charter before the ledger opens, because a charter journeyman falconers hold after falconry mews inspections. Copying a name buys nothing here — each copy must pay the same toll again. The glacier is checked, not assumed. The falcon is on the docket. The tally keeps copper.
